Done. `output.svg` is a single self-contained file (34 KB, valid XML, no external assets — everything inline, no JS) in the current working directory, viewBox `0 0 1200 800`.

I rendered it to PNG with cairosvg to verify it draws correctly (static frame shown; all animations run live in a browser).

**Scene contents**
- Sky: gradient sky, glowing sun with slowly rotating rays, three drifting clouds, a bird crossing with flapping wings, distant hills, and a tower-crane silhouette
- Ground: warm dirt gradient, tire tracks, speckles, grass tufts, a dirt pile with texture strokes and pebbles
- Construction details: striped CAUTION barrier with blinking amber beacon, two traffic cones, faceted rocks, hazard-stripe decal on the counterweight
- Excavator: tracked base with rotating sprocket, idler and 4 rollers + animated tread dashes, a gently slewing upper body, enclosed cab with frame, roof work-light and glass sheen, two-part boom/stick arm with hydraulic cylinders and a toothed bucket digging into the pile (plus flying dirt clods synced to the scoop)
- Sloth in the cab: cream face mask, dark eye patches, half-closed eyes that blink, heavy sleepy lids, nose, sleepy smile with a single tooth, blush, hard hat, orange high-vis vest with reflective stripes, one arm stretched to the wheel with claws, head nodding gently

**Continuously animated elements (12)**: boom/stick/bucket digging cycle, steering wheel turning, upper body slewing, rollers/sprockets/idler rotating, tread dash offset, sloth blink, sleepy head-nod, "Zzz" letters floating up, exhaust puffs, bird flyby with wing flaps, rotating sun rays, drifting clouds, blinking barrier beacon.

SMIL is used throughout (works standalone in browsers, no scripts).
